overview: The Community Development Board continued a public hearing for a special permit at 200 Mystic Avenue to October 30, 2024, and approved previous meeting minutes.

items.title: Special Permit: 200 Mystic Avenue
items.summary: Continued the public hearing for a special permit application to establish a motor vehicle wash at 200 Mystic Avenue to October 30, 2024.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes from September 4, 2024.
